subject: Vendor onboarding kickoff — LumenHealth remit & bank proof needed
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding kickoff — LumenHealth remit & bank proof needed

Hi Sarah,

Great to start the onboarding process — excited to get LumenHealth set up so you can receive POs and payments. To keep things moving on our side, can you please send the following items this week?

- Completed vendor intake (attached: vendor_intake_form.pdf) — legal entity name, DBA if any, physical address, and primary contact for billing.
- Tax ID / EIN and a signed W-9 (or local equivalent).
- Remit-to address (if different from legal address).
- Banking details for ACH OR wire (we require one of the following):
  - A copy of a voided check (bank account + routing visible), OR
  - Bank letter on bank letterhead confirming account holder name and routing/account numbers (signed), OR
  - Bank ACH authorization PDF from your bank.
- Any special PO requirements or purchase order contact (email + phone).

A couple notes from our side: our standard payment terms are Net 30 from invoice receipt unless a different term is negotiated in the contract. We send POs from procurement@redwoodinference.com and our AP team will require an invoice that references the PO number.

If it helps, we can also set up a quick 20-minute call to walk through the form. Proposed times: Thu 4/22 at 10am or Fri 4/23 at 2pm PT — let me know what works.

Thanks,

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: vendor_intake_form.pdf (fillable), onboarding-checklist.txt

Thanks for the heads up — quick internal note:

- Bank letter is fine for initial setup, but AP policy requires either a voided check or bank letter plus a micro-deposit verification before enabling ACH by default. For high-dollar vendors we ask for dual verification.
- Contract has the Net 30 term, no special billing SLAs.
- Please flag if LumenHealth is requesting PO-less invoicing (they indicated standard PO flow in the email).

Hannah — let's accept the bank letter for now and mark the vendor as "bank-letter-pending-micro-deposit". Vivek, can you confirm if we should enable ACH after micro-deposit completes or wait for voided check?

Cheers,
Marissa
Head of Revenue Operations
